findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Rate is the larger source of error (53.52 yds from volume vs 54.15 from rate). Fix the rate model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We OVER-project attempts by 0.84 per player (projected 29.44, actual 28.59).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is under-projected by 0.15 (projected 7.13, actual 7.27).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 75.78, without it 74. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 10/32 (31.25%). Our MAE 75.78 vs the line's 67.22. The book is the better projection.
